title: Software Engineer
description:
We engage the most inspired minds to do their best work wherever they work best—powering the freedom to create worldwide.

WP Engine empowers companies and agencies of all sizes to build, power, manage, and optimize their WordPress websites and applications with confidence. Serving 1.5 million customers across 150+ countries, the global technology company provides premium, enterprise-grade solutions, tools, and services, including specialized platforms for WordPress, industry-tailored eCommerce and agency solution suites, and developer-centric tools like Local, Advanced Custom Fields, and more. WP Engine’s innovative technology and industry-leading expertise are why 8% of the web visits a WP Engine-powered site daily. Learn more at wpengine.com.

What's cool about this job?

Our software engineers build systems that automate services at scale. With technologies like custom Kubernetes controllers and cloud functions, we are able to automate the deployment, enhancement, and maintenance of our Kubernetes platform. The team is continuously looking for ways to make our services more scalable, reliable, and resilient; Learning from past decisions and striving to get better every day.

The day to day


Building automated, scalable services and systems to power our growing infrastructure
Collaborating with an agile team that is passionate about new technologies and delivering high quality and timely code
Working with monitoring and alerting systems to aid engineering and support efforts
Constantly look for opportunities to automate and optimize
Work with Kubernetes solutions across various cloud providers such as Azure, AWS, GCP
Produce quality, testable and maintainable systems with fast feedback loops
Build and enhance infrastructure for serving WordPress on thousands of servers
Be customer inspired and work closely with business partners to incrementally deliver positive outcomes through technology
Develop CI/CD pipelines for pushing code into production


Your expertise and passion


2+ years software engineering experience.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience.
Worked in an agile environment and is passionate about SRE principles.
Proficient in Python or Go programming.
Expertise working with Kubernetes and containerisation.
Experience working with Kubernetes orchestration on hosted cloud service like AWS, GCP or Azure.
Knowledge of infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.
Understanding of the common WordPress technology stack is desirable: Linux, Varnish, Apache/Nginx, MySQL, and PHP.
Has experience (or interest) in: configuration management systems, monitoring systems and computer network technologies.


Perks And Benefits


Company Stock Options (Every employee is an owner in the company)
Health Benefits (100% Paid Employee Medical, Dental, and Vision)
Pension Scheme with a match
Life Insurance and Income Protection (100% Paid)
Supplemental Maternity & Paternity Pay
Employee Assistance Program
Generous Vacation Time (Who doesn’t like time off)
One-time €460 Home Office Stipend
Company Wellness Days and wellness allowance.


At WP Engine, we strive to have the broadest possible view of diversity, going beyond visible differences to include the background, experiences, skills, and perspectives that make each person unique. WP Engine is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, Veteran status, or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Full Stack Developer - Operations Technology
description:
The Operations Technology team is responsible for supporting operation users on reconciliation, asset servicing and reporting. We manage corporate actions and reconciliation systems, which are integrated with other internal subledger systems across the firm. We are also responsible for all reports going out to our counterparties on daily basis, reporting on our trades and positions. The team is located in NY, Miami and Singapore already and we are looking to expand to Dublin to support EU users. This role requires someone with good communication skills, in addition to programming proficiency, to interact with users directly in the region.




Principal Responsibilities

Hands on development and ownership of software solutions.
Collaborating with the rest of the team to architect solutions
Ability to understand and analyze data to find defects and suggests improvements.
Take ownership of project while managing stakeholders’ expectations




Skills Required

3-5 years' of production level dotnet core development experience
Programming experience with a strong understanding of OOP with .NET Core, MS SQL Server, Postgres
Demonstrable experience with streaming patterns: Kafka, micro-services, etc.
Strong coding skills; writing reliable, readable code and providing code review feedback is second nature
Experience of working in an Agile environment (preferably Scrum/ Kanban) and associated tools such as JIRA.
Working knowledge of agile development and dev ops CI/CD practices
Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, including integration and testing
Highly analytical with good problem-solving skills and creativity; able to work independently in a fast-paced environment
Positive individual with strong communication skills; able to interface well with users and other development teams




Skills Desired

Experience building AWS integrated solutions with resiliency
Experience building containers and deploying to Kubernetes
Knowledge of typescript frameworks/libraries such as Angular
UI design and customization through SCCS such as Bootstrap/Material Design
Experience with trading or related applications helpful
Broad understanding of financial services instruments
Development experience in both windows and Linux environment
